description: This file defines a PHP class extending database driver functionality for Microsoft SQL Server, specifically adding Unicode support by prepending 'N' to string literals in queries. It customizes query handling to ensure proper Unicode storage with FreeTDS or ODBTP drivers, and includes a secondary class for recordset handling.

classes.name: ADODB_mssql_n
classes.description: Database driver class for MSSQL with Unicode support by prepending 'N' to literals.

classes.name: ADORecordset_mssql_n
classes.description: Recordset class associated with the MSSQL Unicode driver.

methods.name: _query
methods.description: Overrides the parent _query method to append 'N' to string literals for Unicode compatibility.

methods.name: _appendN
methods.description: Manipulates SQL strings or arrays of SQL strings to prepend 'N' to appropriate literals, ensuring correct Unicode storage in MSSQL.
